svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 09 · San Francisco · 10/12 Hillside Stairways (Common)
svg.desc: Stairs instead of streets where the hill gets too steep. Gardens on both sides, a view at the top. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
